title: Robotics Institute Summer Scholars (RISS)
about: Carnegie Mellon's Robotics Institute Summer Scholars program places undergraduates in summer robotics research, generally June 1 to August 15. About 35 are selected each year. Applications are accepted from 1 November to 20 January (3 PM EST).
requirements: Current undergraduate students only; applicants who do not meet all eligibility criteria are not considered
Applications accepted from November 1 to January 20, 3 PM EST
Program dates generally June 1 to August 15
Approximately 35 applicants selected from several hundred U.S. and international applicants
